$comment: CLIENT CONFIG — the only file (besides brand tokens and the content tree)
a new site edits. Charter §5. Ships with placeholder values so the starter
builds green from a fresh clone; replace every value below per client.
GOLDEN RULE (charter §1): if a value is true for ONE client only, it lives
here — never hardcoded in an Engine file.
NEVER FABRICATE. `geo`, `rating`, and every *Confirmed flag default to
null/false, and the Engine omits the corresponding output entirely rather
than inventing it. A confirmed-false flag is a real answer; leaving it
unconfirmed is what keeps an unverified claim off the page.

business.name: Example Local Services
$comment_identity: Entity-identity fields for the business JSON-LD node. Each is OMITTED
from the schema when blank/null — never emit a guessed NAICS code or a
founding year nobody confirmed. `sameAs` is the highest-value one: it
cites the business's own authoritative profiles (Google Business Profile,
Yelp, Facebook, BBB) so Google can reconcile this site with a known
entity in its graph. Use the REAL profile URLs or leave the array empty.

claimGates.$comment: Per-client claim gates. Each defaults false; Engine withholds the claim until the client confirms it. Add vertical-specific gates in the industry preset.

$comment: Legal-doc + TCPA/A2P posture. Every value is a per-client fact — the
Engine holds NONE of these (charter §1). `effectiveDate` is a HARDCODED
string, NEVER a computed date: a legal document's effective date must not
change silently on every rebuild.
`smsConsentRequired` is a real business decision, not a default to inherit
(charter/task §3). Required = cleanest TCPA position (a lead implies SMS
consent) but no one unwilling to be texted can submit. Optional = no
friction, but the CRM workflow MUST filter on sms_consent before any SMS
action. Decide it deliberately for THIS client; the Engine refuses to build
if it is missing or non-boolean.
`legalReviewedBy` stays null until counsel signs off — core30-lint reads it
as an unresolved publish gate and the legal pages show a draft banner while
it is null. `a2pBrandRegistered` gates turning SMS actions ON in the CRM.

wordmark.$comment: Two-line lockup in the header/footer. Kept explicit rather than split from business.name: where a name breaks is a design decision, and deriving it guesses wrong on most real names.

brand.$comment_footer: logoMark/footerBlurb/footerLegal/favicon each fall back to a sensible derived default when blank (see src/lib/site.js). primaryCta is the mobile bar's main button.
